'''Toh Revo Chryyx''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Con artist/Legends|grifter]]. He was wanted by [[Rokko]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who placed a bounty of fifteen thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] on the Cerean, alive only. [[Jax Pavan]] tracked him down for the Hutt in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], but the Cerean committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] before he could be brought to the Hutt for interrogation and [[Torture/Legends|torture]].<ref name="CN" />
